definitions.explanation: A strategic board game originating in ancient China, played by placing black and white stones to capture territory.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{碁|ご}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: My grandfather is good at Go.

notes:
{碁|ご} is also called {囲碁|いご}.

TERMS:
- {碁盤|ごばん}: Go board
- {碁石|ごいし}: Go stones
- {碁|ご}を{打|う}つ: to play Go

CULTURE:
Go is one of the four arts of the Chinese scholar, along with calligraphy, painting, and music.
